verdict.rationale: The sign-in method of a government tax portal is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only records Akamai 403 edge denials at www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt and at webapp.ftb.ca.gov. Nothing in it describes the MyFTB sign-in method, so there is no evidence of remotely completable credential MFA, nor of any biometric, in-person or mailed-PIN requirement.
